title: HelpDeskAI pricing brief
content: HelpDeskAI lists a $49 monthly starter plan for small support teams. Core feature: AI ticket triage and suggested replies. Target segment: small and mid-market support teams.

metrics.core_feature: AI ticket triage and suggested replies

title: SupportPilot product brief
content: SupportPilot is positioned for larger support operations. The corpus records $99 monthly pricing. Core feature: knowledge-grounded agent assistance. Target segment: mid-market and enterprise teams.

title: AssistFlow product brief
content: AssistFlow is described as an automation-focused support platform. The corpus records $79 monthly pricing. Core feature: workflow automation and analytics. Target segment: growing support organizations.

title: Category trend note
content: AI customer support products increasingly emphasize automation, knowledge assistance, analytics and agent productivity.
